refnamediv.refpurpose: Creates a duration from an ISO 8601 duration string

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
specification
An ISO 8601 duration specification. The format starts with the letter P, for period, followed by the letter T, for time, and one or more integer values, each followed by a period designator:
Period Designator Description
H hours
M minutes
S seconds
The designators must appear in this order, but each is optional. A value may exceed the natural range of its unit, so PT90M and PT1H30M describe the same duration.
In contrast to DateInterval::__construct, the date designators Y, M, W and D are rejected, because years, months, weeks and days do not have a fixed length. Fractional values, such as PT0.5S, are not supported either.
